title: content/projects/<slug>.md — frontmatter
description: The machine-readable contract at the top of each project doc. Everything below the frontmatter is prose and is rendered as-is.

id.description: Must equal the filename slug. Must be unique across content/projects/.

server.description: Must be a key in data/servers.json. An unknown value fails validate.

url.description: Free text subtitle shown under the project name, e.g. "WhatsApp AI · n8n + MongoDB". Not required to be a URL.

href.description: Actual link, if the project has a reachable front end

order.description: Manual sort weight in the project grid. Lower sorts first.

value.description: A literal, or a reference resolved from ingested data at build time. References look like $mongo.<db>.<collection>.docs, $wf.<id>.active, $wf.group.<Group>.active, $server.<id>.state.diskUsedPct.

state.description: Optional colour hint, e.g. the "0 to CRM" tile is broken

workflows.description: n8n workflow ids owned by this project. Cross-linked both ways in the dashboard.

services.description: systemd unit or container names on `server` that this project runs on
